title: Why Paid Ads Bankrupt New Businesses
description:
Every business gets clients through four primary channels: warm outreach, cold outreach, free content, and paid ads. Jumping straight to paid traffic burns capital before your offer is proven. Starting with warm outreach tests your pricing and messaging with zero financial risk.

The Quiet Money Daily Planner (paid), and the free Money Reset checklist: https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/links/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=daily-quiet-money-planner&utm_content=2026-10-26-s0-escape-the-four-core-customer-channels&o=daily-quiet-money-planner
